vocabulary.meaning: 礼物；现在的；出席的；呈现；到场
正确的；右边的；正好；权利；右边；矫正

examples.text: Luck and chance play a part, but "you have to be prepared（prepare的过去分词形式） and have a strategy," he says.
examples.translation: 他说，运气和偶然性确实会起作用，但“你必须做好准备，并制定策略”。
examples.speechText: Luck and chance play a part, but "you have to be prepared and have a strategy," he says.

examples.text: Also, happiness consists（consist的第三人称单数形式） in contentment.
We are so proud of her.
examples.translation: 我们为她感到非常骄傲。
examples.speechText: We are so proud of her.

examples.text: There are many options（option的复数形式） one can try to relieve cold.
examples.translation: 人们可以尝试许多方法来缓解感冒症状。
examples.source: （2015年配套材料·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: There are many options one can try to relieve cold.

examples.text: Reusable containers require more energy and materials（material的复数形式） to produce.
examples.translation: 可重复使用的容器在生产过程中需要更多的能源和材料。
examples.speechText: Reusable containers require more energy and materials to produce.

examples.text: Making your voice heard is important, too, but try to pick your battles.
examples.translation: 让自己的声音被听见也很重要，但尽量选择正确的时机和方式。
examples.source: （2013年配套材料·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: Making your voice heard is important, too, but try to pick your battles.

examples.text: The account is attached to a prepaid card that is currently available in Sweden only, but expected to launch elsewhere in Europe in 2020.
examples.translation: 该账户绑定一张预付卡，目前仅在瑞典提供，预计将于2020年在欧洲其他地区推出。
examples.speechText: The account is attached to a prepaid card that is currently available in Sweden only, but expected to launch elsewhere in Europe in 2020.

examples.text: The study, which is funded（fund的过去分词形式） by the British Heart Foundation, is led by Dr Graham Burdge, a Professor of Cardiovascular Science.
examples.translation: 这项研究由英国心脏基金会资助，并由心血管科学教授Graham Burdge博士领导。
examples.speechText: The study, which is funded by the British Heart Foundation, is led by Dr Graham Burdge, a Professor of Cardiovascular Science.

examples.text: A man who is dissatisfied with his present condition is never happy.
examples.translation: 一个不满于自己现状的人永远不会快乐。
examples.speechText: A man who is dissatisfied with his present condition is never happy.

examples.text: We can find many sports facilities（facility的复数形式） on the playground of this primary school.
examples.translation: 我们可以在这所小学的操场上看到许多体育设施。
examples.speechText: We can find many sports facilities on the playground of this primary school.

examples.text: We don't mean to be rude or thoughtless----so why do we act this way when we really want to help?
examples.translation: 我们并不是有意粗鲁或考虑不周；既然真心想帮忙，为什么却会这样做呢？
examples.speechText: We don't mean to be rude or thoughtless----so why do we act this way when we really want to help?

examples.text: Everything would have been all right.
examples.translation: 本来一切都会很顺利的。
examples.speechText: Everything would have been all right.

examples.text: At most universities teachers can give students advice on how to spend their money.
examples.translation: 在大多数大学，老师能够就如何支配金钱给学生提供建议。
examples.speechText: At most universities teachers can give students advice on how to spend their money.

examples.text: The reason was quite simple: Men had not invented the week.
examples.translation: 原因很简单：那时，人类还没有发明“星期”这种计时方式。
examples.speechText: The reason was quite simple: Men had not invented the week.
